title: Prime Minister shares an article highlighting the growing role of India’s civilisational heritage in shaping global cultural discourse
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, today shared an article by Union Minister Shri Gajendra Singh Shekhawat, highlighting how India's civilisational heritage has a growing role in shaping global cultural discourse. Shri Shekhawat highlighted the first SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum and the Indraprastha Communiqué, which sets out a framework for stronger cultural cooperation, exploring how India can take its rich civilisational traditions to a wider global audience through heritage conservation, cultural research, innovation, and creative enterprise. The Prime Minister's Office posted on X: “India's civilisational heritage has a growing role in shaping global cultural discourse. Union Minister Shri @gssjodhpur writes about the first SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum and the Indraprastha Communiqué, which sets out a framework for stronger cultural cooperation. He explores how India can take its rich civilisational traditions to a wider global audience through heritage conservation, cultural research, innovation and creative enterprise. https://indianexpress.com/article/opinion/columns/sco-civilisational-dialogue-forum-lets-create-spaces-where-civilisations-engage-with-dignity-10977257/lite/ ” India's civilisational heritage has a growing role in shaping global cultural discourse.
